Home - Airport Bird and Game Lodge
Skip to content
Serenity awaits…
Experience Tranquility at Airport Bird and Game Lodge
Tucked away in suburbia you will discover a little piece of unspoilt African soil, a mere 10-minute drive from OR Tambo International Airport via our complimentary airport shuttle. Airport Bird & Game Lodge has been in existence for more than 30 years, with a rich history and countless satisfied corporate and independent travellers and tour groups visiting the property.
Book today and experience true African Hospitality!
BOOK NOW
Stay in Comfort, Surrounded by Nature
Breathe In .Breathe Out
27 comfortably appointed rooms ranging from Standard to Superior and Deluxe rooms, will ensure a memorable stay.
The Standard room range looks out on rolling lawns and a sparkling pool, whilst Superior and Deluxe rooms give you a bird’s eye view of the veldt where Springbuck, Impala, Fallow deer and Nyala roam freely.

Experience South Africa s Natural Beauty
Nature at Your Doorstep
The ideal stay for birders at heart
Listed as one of the birding hotspots with Cornell University Ornithology Lab, our lodge is home to some of the 143 recorded bird species in the Kempton Park area. Download your free EBird spotting chart . Forward your finds and photos with your name and date for inclusion in our weekly Facebook “Spot the Bird” post.
Business or Leisure you will catch a glimpse of the wildlife..
Offering a unique experience for nature enthusiasts and as part of our rehabilitation conservation programme some of the animals are tame enough for you to have beautiful photo opportunities in their natural surroundings. The property is home to Blesbuck, Springbuck, Black Impala, Impala, Duiker and Nyala

Useful Information
Digital First
Airport Game Lodge prides itself on working towards a paperless environment and all communication with guests are therefor on a digital platform (Whatsapp)
Important information with regard to emergencies, general property information, wake-up calls and communication with Reception are facilitated through this digital platform.
Airport Transfers
Make use of the complimentary airport shuttle, we are situated a mere 10 minutes from OR Tambo International Airport. Our friendly staff will transport you from the airport in no time in three easy steps; forward your flight details and cell number, receive the pick-up procedure via WhatsApp and you are on the way!
Pet Policy
We love our furry friends, however kindly note that no pets are allowed on the property for the safety and health of the game. You are welcome to make use of the Pets-en-Transit Pet Hotel, only 400m away from our doorstep. You can contact them on +27 (011) 979 1672
